label: Memory chips (HBM, DRAM, NAND)
headline: Contract prices for DRAM and NAND are almost nine times what they were a year ago.
rule: Equal weight across the call's owners, bought at the first close after the call is published and held until the next call replaces it. Prices in US dollars, dividends included.

picks.name: SK Hynix
picks.role: The leading HBM supplier and a top DRAM maker. It sells almost nothing but memory, so memory prices reach its results directly.

picks.name: Micron Technology
picks.role: The largest US memory maker, selling DRAM, HBM and NAND. Memory is its whole business.

picks.name: Sandisk
picks.role: NAND flash and SSDs, spun out of Western Digital in February 2025. The only pure NAND maker listed in the US.

picks.name: Samsung Electronics
picks.role: A top DRAM, HBM and NAND maker, but phones, displays and its foundry dilute the memory exposure.

picks.name: Kioxia
picks.role: NAND flash, the former Toshiba Memory, listed in Tokyo since December 2024. It shares its fabs with Sandisk through a joint venture.
